title: Questions 176-180 refer to the following job advertisement and e-mail.
passage_1:
Wanted: Hotel Inspectors

The Northern Rest, the region’s leading accommodation guide, is looking for people to join our team of inspectors. We are expanding our coverage to take in guesthouses in the coastal towns.

Responsibilities:

  • Stay at a minimum of three assigned properties each month.
  • Remain completely anonymous throughout each stay to ensure you receive the same level of service as an ordinary guest.
  • Submit a comprehensive written report within 48 hours of checking out.

Requirements:

  • A keen eye for detail and consistently high standards.
  • Excellent writing skills.

To Apply: Please send your CV and a portfolio of your published work to Marion Delacroix at editor@thenorthernrest.com by 5 September.

To:Marion Delacroix <editor@thenorthernrest.com>
From:Tomasz Ferrier <t.ferrier@postmark.net>
Date:28 August
Subject:Application for Inspector Position
Attachment:Ferrier_CV, Hospitality_Diploma

Dear Ms. Delacroix,

I am writing to apply formally for the inspector position advertised on your Web site. As a loyal reader of The Northern Rest, I admire your commitment to drawing attention to small independent places.

My background includes more than twelve years in the hotel industry. I previously served as head manager at The Larchmere, where I introduced a seasonal turndown service and trained staff in handling guest complaints. This background allows me to assess a stay with a clear sense of what good service costs and requires. I have also written accommodation reviews for a number of print and online titles as a freelancer.

I have attached my CV and a copy of my hospitality diploma for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Tomasz Ferrier
